title: AW27 Women's Trending Trims Report
summary: AW27 women's trims: horn, corozo and mother-of-pearl buttons, jewelled buckles, oxidised metals, lace insets and matte gold.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Milano Unica trims: horn, corozo, mother-of-pearl and bio-based polyester buttons, oxidised metal pulls, chains and recycled leather labels<sup>[1]</sup>
- APLF trims include patinated brass buckles, hammered studs, horn closures, magnetic closures, invisible zips, jewelled buckles, decorative chains, oversized resin buckles and rubberised webbing<sup>[2]</sup>
- Cited looks include sculptural pleats, funnel necks, round-cut waists (Jil Sander), padded shoulders (Carven), oversized fur coats (Saint Laurent), teddy-bear coats (Loewe) and all-over lace (Saint Laurent)<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Trims table
sections.body:
| Trim | Application | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Horn and corozo buttons | Coats, blazers | Core |
| Jewelled buckles and chains | Bags, belts | Rising |
| Lace insets | Dresses, tops | Rising |
| Matte gold hardware | Bags, jewellery | Rising |

design_implications: - Prefer natural or bio-based buttons where verified.
